reconcile.note: Clarke identifies the house in Capernaum as Peter's home where Jesus lodged rather than property he owned, leaving the nowhere-to-lay-his-head saying intact.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible sets Jesus's claim to have nowhere to lay his head against Mark's references to a house in Capernaum.

sides.snippet: The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.
sides.verseText: Jesus said to him, \"The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.\"

sides.snippet: It happened, that he was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples
sides.verseText: It happened, that he was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.
